turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have about twenty minutes. Before anything else, tell me why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone picked up a phone to call me.
I'll stand. Your own procedure says the parent gets a call before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. I'm waiting.
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. Easy is not what this is going to be. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. And that's twice you've tried to flatter me instead of showing me a single document. I'm writing down that you asked me to accept the zero before you've told me what it's based on.
